reviewNotes: Maps padding and attribution respond to sheet placement and rotation without taking route camera ownership.
Disconnected Notes retains a reachable opaque app surface.
Browser Calendar selection is enabled only by the explicit test-mocks build and is denied by production-bundle audit.
Page reading requires a committed, nonloading, nonfailed, non-external-only document.
The upstream delta changes two Cloud release-tooling files; phone runtime source is unchanged.
finalReviewNotes: Cross-turn deduplication only hides exact text for the same completed proposal while its card is in the rendered history; pending, foreign, quoted and offscreen receipts stay visible.
Browser Calendar links preserve only an already selected test-mocks source; production and native links retain normal authority.
Native page sharing remains distinct from explicit reading of committed web pages.
Shared Notes retains storage-access warnings and registers its browser document provider before use.
